stories.title: Arizona town approves business license for immigration detention facility
stories.summary: The Arizona town of Marana has approved a business license for Management & Training Corporation to run an immigration detention center in a former state prison.

stories.title: 5 injured, including children, in multi-vehicle crash in west Phoenix
stories.summary: Five people were transported to the hospital, including three children, the Phoenix Fire Department said.

stories.title: Pedestrian dead after hit by car in south Phoenix, police say
stories.summary: A man was killed after being struck by a vehicle near 19th Avenue and Baseline Road on Tuesday.

stories.title: Attorney general urges delay on 747-acre data center campus in Arizona
stories.summary: Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes is hoping a vote on a proposed SpaceX data center project in Cochise County will be delayed.

stories.title: 'I’ve never wanted to find something so bad': Silver Bell Estates man finds missing toddler near Eloy
stories.summary: After drones and helicopters failed to spot the 2-year-old, a longtime resident searching on foot found her hiding in a desert bush. She is now home safe.

stories.title: Lake levels expected to rise as SRP releases more water
stories.summary: Visitors of Bartlett Lake may notice water levels rising after SRP releases more water.

stories.title: One of Phoenix's most popular outdoor destinations is set to close for major renovations
stories.summary: North Mountain Park will close on Dec. 1 to undergo long-awaited renovations and is anticipated to reopen in Spring 2028.

stories.title: Teen wanted in Wisconsin homicide case arrested at Tempe Marketplace
stories.summary: The Milwaukee Police Department wanted the 19-year-old for the deadly shooting of an 18-year-old.

stories.title: Teen wanted in a serious shooting in Connecticut arrested in Mesa
stories.summary: The New Haven Police Department wanted the 17-year-old for a September shooting that critically injured another juvenile.

stories.title: Grand Canyon hotels will reopen as water access is restored
stories.summary: Overnight lodging will resume at facilities in the South Rim of the Grand Canyon on Nov. 20.

stories.title: Enjoy the cooler temperatures and sunny skies in Arizona
stories.summary: An extended, very preliminary look ahead to Thanksgiving Day shows sunny skies in the Valley with temperatures in the low 70s.

stories.title: 'It's going to hurt' | Queen Creek residents will face higher water bills due to new fee
stories.summary: Queen Creek residents face higher water bills as the town council implements a new fee to secure groundwater supplies for future generations.
